(iv) To understand this correlation, cell wise DCR and UL-PDR performance is compared for a TSP for QE Dec’2022. It is observed that 23.6% of total cells, having Cell_Q(90) of DCR ≤ 2%, were having UL-PDR more than 2%. The same is represented in Figure 8. While the other TSP, having relatively poor DCR, has a better packet drop rate. Therefore, it is evident that it is possible to have better DCR performance at the cost of poor packet drop rate which results in call muting.
